name: folklore-variant-evidence
description: Retrieve ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and review source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Use when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence
author: K-Dense-AI
summary_zh: 通过 Folklore 临床变异解读 MCP，检索 ClinGen 基因与疾病有效性证据，核查 GRCh38 生殖系 SNV 或简单插入缺失变异，适合科研代理进行确定性分支和文献追踪。
